result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one card shows a stuck/permanent loading spinner overlaying the restaurant image, which looks visually broken.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a circular loading spinner permanently overlaid in the center of the food image, suggesting the image failed to finish loading or the spinner was never dismissed.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading spinner is hidden once the image finishes loading; add a timeout/fallback so a failed image load removes the spinner and shows a placeholder instead.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the restaurant cards are icon-only controls without visible text labels, which may be unclear to screen reader users.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g., aria-label='Add to favorites') to the heart icon buttons.
